paragraphs: Nordsense sells smart sensors and data for waste management, and the company states a mission of redefining that industry. The about page describes a complete end-to-end waste optimization solution based on IoT sensor technology, from a start-up established in 2015 in Denmark.

That same sentence names cities, municipalities, waste operators, collectors, haulers, facility management, and campuses in Europe, Israel, and North America. One homepage case study describes San Francisco facing street cleaning requests and unsanitary streets before a smart sensor journey in 2019. Another case study names Local Government Economic Services, a non-profit organization in Israel that works with municipalities, and 9 Israeli municipalities using smart sensors.

The homepage lists advantages including cutting carbon emissions from collections, along with fuel consumption and driving distances. Another stated advantage is preventing overflowing bins and illegal dumping. The pages also offer understanding of waste generation behavior so that participation in recycling programs can increase.

quote.text: We need more than yesterday's data to build tomorrow's waste cycles
